summary: Full frontend regression after design/logo/stats/deep-link/prefill batch. ALL priority acceptance criteria PASS. Punctuation wrap audit across 6 routes x 3 viewports (1920/1440/375) = 0 headings with '.' at line start and 0 lone-period lines. Home 'THREE GENERATIONS. ONE COMMITMENT.' renders cleanly at all sizes. Featured Products deep links: blue-duct card -> /products#product-blue-duct with target scrolled to y=72px (in-viewport), agricultural card -> /products#product-agricultural at y=73px. Please share pricing and availability.' Mobile 375: 1px horizontal separators (border-top on items 1,2), no floating fragments. Header on scroll becomes translucent white (rgba 255,255,255,0.847) with backdrop-filter: blur(11.26px). WhatsApp button: href=https://wa.me/919449528205, border-radius=0px (square). Reveal-img fix VERIFIED — after full scroll, both Home reveal-img elements and all 4 Products page reveal-img elements have '.in-view' class. Mocked Contact form submit: success toast shown, 0 network calls to formspree.io. Mobile menu: single visible close icon in sheet header, opens/closes. 0 console errors on all 6 routes. 0 horizontal overflow on mobile 375 for all 6 routes.
critical_code_review_comments: Stats.jsx count-up animation runs for 2500ms; if user scrolls fast, mid-animation values (e.g., 1855 instead of 1984) may be captured in screenshots — final rendered value is correct once animation completes. Non-issue functionally.
Logo.jsx CSS var reference: red = hsl(var(--brand-green)) — brand-green token actually stores red (#941425). Naming is misleading for future maintainers (already flagged in iteration_5).
useScrollReveal now correctly toggles .in-view on all .reveal-img elements after scrolling — the previous iteration_5 HIGH bug is fully resolved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is stable. All punctuation wrap, deep-link, prefill, stats, logo/favicon, Anton, marquee, glass header, square WhatsApp, mocked forms, and reveal-img flows are green. If new changes: re-run punctuation audit at 3 widths, deep links from FeaturedProducts, and /products -> /contact prefill. Forms remain MOCKED (REACT_APP_FORMSPREE_ID empty) — success toast without formspree.io network call is expected behavior, not a bug.
